profile.headline: Principal Engineer | Distributed Systems | Data Architecture, Design, Scaling, and Availability
profile.summary:
I have worked in all phases of software engineering during my career over the past 25 years, including hands-on technical engineering roles, technical product management, engineering leadership, data engineering, system integrations, technical training and instruction, data architect, and more.  

I have full stack engineering experience but my technical area of expertise lies at designing, implementing, scaling, and optimizing data-driven, domain-oriented distributed systems.
